# 发布 lite：推送 lite/* tag（如 lite/v0.1.0，版本号由用户定）时构建 Vite 静态站，
# 上传到 OSS 发布桶（[BUCKET]，IaC 见 manifests/project/src/file126.tf），并刷新 CDN 缓存。
#
# 对齐 qtclass 的 deploy-lite.yml 模式与本仓 deploy-studio.yml：
#   lite/* tag → Actions（npm ci + vite build，ossutil cp）→ OSS 桶（[BUCKET]，静态网站托管）
#   → CDN（example.com）→ 用户浏览器
#
# 触发说明：用 tag 精确匹配 lite/ 前缀，避免其他 tag 误触发；不设 workflow_dispatch（部署不手动触发）。
#
# 所需 GitHub secrets（org / repo 级，与 deploy-studio.yml 共用）：
#   - ALIYUN_ACCESS_KEY_ID / ALIYUN_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET（secret）：RAM 用户 AccessKey（OSS 上传 + CDN 刷新）

name: Deploy Lite

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'lite/**'

concurrency:
  group: deploy-lite
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  OSS_BUCKET: [BUCKET]
  OSS_ENDPOINT: oss.example.com
  CDN_DOMAIN: example.com

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    name: Build Lite & Deploy to OSS
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'

      - name: Install
        working-directory: src/lite
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build
        working-directory: src/lite
        run: npm run build

      - name: Setup ossutil
        uses: manyuanrong/setup-ossutil@v3.0
        with:
          endpoint: ${{ env.OSS_ENDPOINT }}
          access-key-id: ${{ secrets.ALIYUN_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          access-key-secret: ${{ secrets.ALIYUN_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET }}

      # 缓存策略：哈希资源（assets/）长缓存；固定名入口文件（index.html / 404.html）必须 no-cache
      - name: Upload long-cache assets
        working-directory: src/lite
        run: |
          ossutil cp dist/ oss://${{ env.OSS_BUCKET }}/ -r -f \
            --exclude "index.html" --exclude "404.html" \
            --meta "Cache-Control:public,max-age=31536000"

      # 入口与单页回退（404.html 由 index.html 复制，静态托管 error_document 指向）
      - name: Upload entry files
        working-directory: src/lite
        run: |
          cp dist/index.html dist/404.html
          ossutil cp dist/index.html oss://${{ env.OSS_BUCKET }}/index.html -f --meta "Cache-Control:no-cache"
          ossutil cp dist/404.html oss://${{ env.OSS_BUCKET }}/404.html -f --meta "Cache-Control:no-cache"

      - name: Refresh CDN
        run: |
          pip install aliyun-python-sdk-cdn
          python -c "
          from aliyunsdkcore.client import AcsClient
          from aliyunsdkcdn.request.v20180510.RefreshObjectCachesRequest import RefreshObjectCachesRequest
          import os
          cli = AcsClient(os.environ['ALIYUN_ACCESS_KEY_ID'], os.environ['ALIYUN_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET'], 'cn-hangzhou')
          req = RefreshObjectCachesRequest()
